==Description==
The '''Snow Golem''' was an [[Enemies|enemy]] that appeared exclusively in [[Outpost 32 (Frost Invasion)|Outpost 32]] as part of the [[Frost Invasion Event]]. For its debut, it had a high amount of health and walked slightly slowly. Upon its death, it spawned two [[Snow Minion (Frost Invasion)|Snow Minion]]s. The combined effort could overwhelm weak defenses.

==Appearance==
The '''Snow Golem''' had white skin, while its legs and torso were light grey. Its entire body had a snow texture. It was faceless and larger than the average enemy. The '''Snow Golem''' wore grey diamond-plated armbands. Its torso had small snow humanoid sticking out of it. On its arms were ice blocks and on its head were snow crystals. Its legs were slightly carved in around its knees.

==Strategy==
*You can use high DPS towers, such as the [[Minigunner]] or [[Ranger]], to defeat the '''Snow Golem''' with relative ease.
**You can also use towers that hit multiple enemies, like the [[Mortar]] and [[Pursuit]], to deal with the [[Snow Minion (Frost Invasion)|Sniw Minion]]s that the '''Snow Golem''' spawns.
*The [[Toxic Gunner]] can be used to greatly reduce the speed of the '''Snow Golem''', making it far easier to kill.
*As with all enemies in the [[Frost Invasion Event]], the [[Pyromancer]] deals double fire damage to the '''Snow Golem''' (though normal damage is left unchanged).
*If a '''Snow Golem''' is near the end of the path on low health, try not to kill it and let it enter the base. When it is killed, it will spawn two [[Snow Minion (Frost Invasion)|Snow Minion]]s which can easily run into your base and result in a defeat.
